lines.text: A secret GTA 6 radio station that you unlock with your phone?
It's called The Vault, and it never shows up on the dial.
Guides from Destructoid and PowerPyx say it starts in Vice City.
There's a nightclub called The Vault, with a red poster of a mask.
Open the WAiNK app on your in-game phone and scan that poster.
Do that, and the station unlocks.
Then hop in any vehicle and tune in.
Guides say it plays electronic and rave music.
They disagree on the exact spot, so check your map first.
